title: (What's the Story) Morning Glory?
studio_context: Rockfield Studios, Wales, May-June 1995, a week after he joined; produced by Owen Morris and Noel Gallagher. Some Might Say, cut in February with McCarroll, is the one track he is not on.

drum_performances.name: Alan White
drum_performances.why_it_matters: His first record with the band and its best known: Wonderwall's off-beat snare on hot rods, Don't Look Back in Anger's mid-tom gallop, Morning Glory's straight eighths, Champagne Supernova's crash ridden in eighths.

evidence.note: White on all but Some Might Say, which is McCarroll's.
